mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO security_alert_log (event_id, request_id, trace_id, alert_type, alert_level, user_id, client_ip, method, path, message, detail_json, occurred_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{requestId}, #{traceId}, #{alertType}, #{alertLevel}, #{userId}, #{clientIp}, #{method}, #{path}, #{message}, #{detailJson}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE security_alert_log SET handled = 1, handled_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND handled = 0
mapper.select: SELECT alert_type AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM security_alert_log GROUP BY alert_type ORDER BY value DESC
